proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Query keys and caching
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: Switch between todo and done. Inspect Query Devtools and verify different keys; no cross-filter content leakage. Cancel a request by switching rapidly.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: Never include access tokens or raw private task titles in a query key; tenant scope belongs in a secure key namespace and server authorization.
